purpose: Teach: 小平/小樽/明石/近江/杉並/伏見/新庄/川越

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、東京小平市の研究所と連携しろ
lines.en: Establish a liaison with our research facility in Kodaira, Tokyo.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Direct eye contact. Each phrase lands with quiet finality. No warmth—purely transactional. Measured cadence, like reading a checklist.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。北海道小樽の支店の月次報告を確認します
lines.en: Understood. I'll verify the monthly report from our Otaru branch in Hokkaido.
lines.style: Immediate, compliant acknowledgment. Quiet and steady. Slight uptick at the end as he internalizes the task. Professional but not stiff—the tone of someone taking mental notes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、兵庫県明石市の工場を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our manufacturing operations in Akashi, Hyogo.
lines.style: Firm instruction, no negotiation. Pauses minimally between clauses. The same measured authority as before—this is how work gets done. Breath control steady throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。滋賀県近江地区の取引先と連携します
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate with our business partners in the Ōmi region, Shiga.
lines.style: Confirmation without hesitation. Rapid intake before speaking. Brisk, efficient tone. He's already mentally moving to execution. No embellishment—just the work ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、東京杉並区にショールームを開けろ
lines.en: Open a showroom in Suginami, Tokyo.
lines.style: Sharp, direct command. Slight emphasis on the location—he's laying down a specific directive. Controlled tempo. The speaker expects compliance and efficiency in return.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。京都市伏見の老舗酒蔵と提携します
lines.en: Understood. I'll establish a partnership with the historic sake brewery in Fushimi, Kyoto.
lines.style: Steady affirmation with a note of interest—sake breweries are heritage-grade partnerships. Slight warmth creeps in here. Still quick, still professional, but touching something with more weight than logistics.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、山形県新庄の物流拠点を強化しろ
lines.en: Reinforce our distribution hub in Shinjo, Yamagata.
lines.style: Final directive of the sequence. Tone hasn't wavered—still authoritative, still measured. But there's a subtle sense of wrapping up. The same precision as the others, no softening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。埼玉県川越の支店長と打ち合わせします
lines.en: Understood. I'll schedule a meeting with the branch manager in Kawagoe, Saitama.
lines.style: Final confirmation. A beat of closure—he's understood the full scope. Clear, unhurried delivery. The faintest sense of completing a checklist. Professional to the end.
